Public build_coverage_report keeps a justified no-scope result distinct from an unconfigured or uninventoried graph.
Empty supported populations expose zero named counts and null zero-denominator percentages, including repaired runtime fields and units.
Public generated document equals report_projection for the same kind, identifier and mode.
to_dict, parsed to_json, and the exact embedded JSON of to_markdown agree field for field.
Repeated generation over identical captured inputs is byte-deterministic.
Generation and validation preserve the immutable snapshot digest and retained input bytes.
A pre-existing generated report in a separately prepared fixture does not change the semantic report input digest or coverage counts.
A changed authored input alters semantic identity or yields its actual validation finding; prior report success cannot be retained.
An authored report with forged counts is rejected by recomputation with REPORT_RESULT rather than accepted as authority.
